column1: # L1 null check: repeated episodes, no learning (2026-10-28; docs/learning_design.md §3).
# r1k-none (arms/rung1_cap.tsv: the capped fire-sale reference bank) with
# BANKRUN_EPISODES=20, at one mixed cell (mu 0.5, lambda 0.1 / 0.9). Common seeding,
# so each run's population and episode-1 seeds are those of r1k-none's runs at that
# cell: episode 1 must equal r1k-none run for run.
# Reading, stated before the run (a gate, not a hypothesis test):
#   - lambda constant within every run (no learning is built yet);
#   - P(fail) and the I - C withdrawal gap flat in the episode number (slopes ~0),
#     and P(fail) pooled over episodes 2-20 within sampling error of r1k-none's.
# A trend here would be a reset bug (state carried between episodes), not learning.
# Cost: 20x a single-episode cell (250 runs x 20 episodes); walltime is a guess,
# r1k-none's per-cell time was not recorded locally.
